title: Keyless web search: the product's Brave engine (impersonated_fetch) gets HTTP 429 while a plain-UA curl from the same host gets a 20-result Brave page in the same minute, so keyless web_search returns zero rows on this network (DDG unreachable, Mojeek 403)
scenario: in-process BraveSearchBackend.search('Dixon Technologies') -> SearchError HTTP 429; curl -A 'Mozilla/5.0' search.brave.com same query -> 200, 20 data-type=web blocks. Not a regression of R15-RESEARCH-008 (rotation and the 25 s cap hold); filed for 0.9.1.
